title: YourMondayMotivator: "My Life sucks!"
html:
Have you said that before? I have and I'm sure you have too. Maybe even a few times a week when things aren't going your way. At those times you might remember the pearls people have passed onto you: "There is always someone worse off than you." "I cried because I had no shoes until I met a man who had no feet." etc. But really, who cares. Life sucks now! Not because I have no shoes or feet but because I feel like the world is about to crash down on me and my head explode...

It's not quite right though is it? The World generally does not end and another day starts. It happens quite naturally too because the sun comes up and sheds some light on the situation. It's at this point you are the one who decides if the World is going to crash down on you. It is at this exact moment in time that you decide if your head is going to explode. It is always you who decides. Only you have the power to choose what your persona is going to be at the start of a new day. Maybe choose before you open your eyes for the first time so nothing or no one can decide for you. So my thought for the day is how about choosing a happy persona and then let the World crash down on you just before you go to sleep. It might just make it easier to get through any day.
